content:
Here is your 7-day content calendar tailored for @garvit.irl, focusing on high-value AI/automation/entrepreneurship content for the Indian professional audience.

## DAY 1 — Friday 04 Sept
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** How to automate lead qualification using Zapier & ChatGPT
**Post Time:** 7:15 PM
**Hook:** "Stop manually reading every lead form—here is how I qualify my clients while I sleep."
**Trigger Word:** ZAPIER

## DAY 2 — Saturday 05 Sept
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** 5 AI side hustles you can start this weekend (No coding required)
**Post Time:** 6:45 PM
**Hook:** "Stop scrolling, start building. Here are 5 AI-powered side hustles for the Indian market."
**Trigger Word:** HUSTLE

## DAY 3 — Sunday 06 Sept
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** My "Sunday Reset" tech stack for peak productivity on Monday
**Post Time:** 7:30 PM
**Hook:** "Most people dread Monday. I use these 3 AI tools to automate my week before it even starts."
**Trigger Word:** STACK

## DAY 4 — Monday 07 Sept
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** Breakdown of an AI-powered content workflow (Idea to Post in 30 mins)
**Post Time:** 7:00 PM
**Hook:** "I spent 4 hours on content creation until I built this AI system. Now it takes me 30 minutes."
**Trigger Word:** SYSTEM

## DAY 5 — Tuesday 08 Sept
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** Live demo: Cloning your voice for multilingual content (Hindi/English)
**Post Time:** 6:30 PM
**Hook:** "I just cloned my voice to record videos in 3 languages without speaking a word of them."
**Trigger Word:** VOICE

## DAY 6 — Wednesday 09 Sept
**Format:** Carousel
**Topic:** The "AI-Resistant" skills you need to learn in 2024
**Post Time:** 7:00 PM
**Hook:** "AI won't replace you, but a human using AI will. Here are the 4 skills that will keep you relevant."
**Trigger Word:** SKILL

## DAY 7 — Thursday 10 Sept
**Format:** Reel
**Topic:** How to use Claude 3.5 Sonnet to rewrite your boring emails into high-converting copy
**Post Time:** 7:45 PM
**Hook:** "Stop sending emails that get ignored. Use this specific Claude prompt to boost your response rate."
**Trigger Word:** PROMPT
